title: All Decked Out | KEY.co
description_expanded: Ascending to the second floor, guests are greeted by a gourmet kitchen outfitted with top-tier stainless steel appliances, including a wine cooler and expansive island seating. This opens to a secondary living room and a dining area, making it a hub for gathering and feasting. Outdoor living is celebrated with two balconies offering different vistas—the front with a cozy porch swing and the rear boasting stunning gulf views and an al fresco dining setup. The luxurious master suite on this level features a king-sized bed and a spa-like bathroom. The top floor hosts another grand master suite with dramatic Gulf views and an opulent bathroom with a freestanding tub and dual shower systems. A private media room with a 70-inch TV offers a secluded retreat for relaxation. This home is not just a place to stay—it is a sublime escape where every moment and every view encapsulates the essence of Gulf luxury living.
